issues.description: Method signature mismatch for Stock.findStockIngredient: the template implementation declares findStockIngredient(String name, boolean caseSensitive) but the problem statement UML and the solution implementation declare/use findStockIngredient(String). In the template, other methods (add and take) call findStockIngredient with a single String argument; with the current two-parameter signature those call sites do not match and will cause a compilation error and confusion for students trying to follow the UML/solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template API with the UML and solution. Either (A) change the template method signature to public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name) and update its implementation accordingly, or (B) add a single-parameter overload in the template: public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name) { return findStockIngredient(name, false); }. This will make existing single-argument calls in add/take compile and match the problem specification.
